title: Urgent Repairs
description: Allan was transporting hunting goods to Mondstadt, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...

mainQuestExcel.title: Urgent Repairs
mainQuestExcel.description: Allan was transporting hunting goods to Mondstadt, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...

dialogs.text: #Th—Thank you, {NICKNAME}, I can't believe my luck... I was sure I was done for...
This cart is loaded up with everything the hunters managed to catch. Draff had me deliver it to the city.
I'm... not the best hunter in the world, but a simple delivery is something I should be able to handle. Or so I thought...
I very nearly messed the whole thing up. This attack was completely out of the blue. I guess they must have been after the goods. It's a good thing you showed up when you did.
Erm, it's not easy for me to ask, but... My cart was damaged in the attack, and it's my only way out of here.
I'm sure the woods around here would have the materials I need for any repairs, but I just can't bring myself to leave my goods unattended.
If it's not too much hassle, would you be able to take a look around and help me find a <color=#00E1FFFF>Sturdy Plank</color>?

It just needs patching up here and there, just enough so it can make it to Mondstadt.
There's bound to be some useful timber in the woods around here.

flow.stepDescription: Give the Sturdy Plank to Allan

dialogs.text: That's plenty, in just two seconds I'll have this...
Ahhh! They're back, Traveler, they're back!
You're a life-saver! They are awfully persistent, aren't they? I wonder what those hunters caught that is so irresistible ...
I have nothing but admiration for Draff, managing to hunt such fine specimens. *sigh* If only I could learn to hunt like him...
Well, first things first. Better get this old thing into the city.
Argh, you're not going to believe this... I was almost done repairing the cart, but they did a little bit more damage when they attacked again...
Things can only get worse the longer I stay here. I need to fix this as soon as possible. There was some rope in the back, but the hilichurls must have nabbed it.
Traveler — may I trouble you to look around the area and see if you can find some <color=#00E1FFFF>rope</color>?

There should be some rope in the woods.
That should do it. It feels like it could fall apart at any moment, but as long it gets me back to Mondstadt I'll be fine.
Thanks for everything! I'm good to go now. Get in touch next time you're in Springvale and let's get a drink!
...As long as you don't drink like Draff, that is.

Don't worry, I've got this.
Fantastic! I'll be waiting right here. Please don't be too long though, I feel like they might come back...
Come on, you've got this!
Please, I'm begging you! They might still be nearby... I need to disappear as soon as possible, and you're the only one who can help make that happen!
In for a penny...
Wonderful! There should be some in the woods.
I have other things to do.
But... This is the final step, I just need the rope and then I can take things from there! Sorry to trouble you...
